takeaways.text: Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **10.9 yd** downfield by the throw (n=247, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (83%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (10.0 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
